text: A logged-in customer can get a CSV of all their orders from their account page: order id, date, each book's title, ISBN, quantity and price, total, status and shipping address.

source.sentence: Customers should be able to download their order history from their account page, as a CSV file.

text: The export contains only the requesting customer's data, behind their session cookie (404 for anyone else's export).
When a customer with up to 500 orders asks for an export, the CSV is ready within 5 minutes, measured from the request to the file being downloadable.
Runs on the existing VPS with the SQLite file and the outbox; no new paid service.
When a customer asks for more than 10 exports in a minute, the API answers 429 and builds none of the extra exports.
When an export cannot be built, the customer gets an email saying so within 10 minutes, and the shop owners see the failure in the job's log.
